ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: divine foresight
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Open your eyes upon the threads of fate. For a time, every threat the storyteller sends against your colony is revealed to you in a prophecy before it arrives, giving your people time to prepare.\n\nThe prophecies are always true: no threat is created, the coming ones are only foreseen and held back a little. As your divinity grows your sight reaches further ahead. Tier 2: names the enemy faction, reveals whether a champion leads it, and also foresees plagues. Tier 3: reveals where and how the enemy will arrive, their tactics and their strength. Interventions of rival gods are foreseen too.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: mending touch
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Lay your hand upon one of your people and close their wounds. Bleeding wounds are healed first.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: manna from heaven
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Food falls from the sky for your hungry faithful. The more followers you have, the more you can provide.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: smite
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Call down lightning upon the enemies of the faith. Mighty gods strike more than once.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: divine inspiration
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Whisper to a follower in a dream, kindling a random inspiration within them.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: divine revelation
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Your prophet preaches a revelation to the faithful. Doubt melts away, believers grow more certain, and heretics may be moved to return to the faith.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: humble a false god
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Your prophet challenges a rival god in your name. Its power is diminished, the more so the more followers you have, and for a time its curses cannot touch your colony and its raids are led by no champion.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: bountiful harvest
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Your prophet blesses the fields. Crops in the area grow by leaps and bounds.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: divine terror
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Your prophet reveals a glimpse of your true face to the enemy. Hostile people in the area flee in terror.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: resurrection
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Your prophet calls a fallen believer back from beyond. The body must not yet be dessicated. This is the greatest gift you can give, and it costs dearly.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: ascension
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Raise a devout follower (certainty 80% or more) into a demigod: every skill +8, mood +30, little pain, half damage taken, armored skin, quick healing and much more. A demigod learns divine abilities from your domains as they grow in level, and uses them by drawing on your faith.\n\nYou can have as many demigods as your divine tier.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: incarnation
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: Descend into the flesh of a chosen follower for one day. The vessel becomes faster, stronger, more perceptive, feels no pain and shrugs off harm. When the god departs, the vessel is left exhausted for two days.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: send the Seraphim
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: The prophet calls down the god's highest messenger: a Seraphim of six burning wings. For three days it fights for the colony on its own, speaking in arcs of holy fire and pillars of judgement, hurling enemies away, shielding the faithful and calling winged beholders to its side. Guide it with its commands.

ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.label: unleash Tiamat
ImAGod.DivinePowerDef.description: The prophet tears open the deep and lets the mother of monsters into the world: Tiamat, the five-headed dragon of chaos. For three days she fights for the colony on her own, breathing fire, lightning, venom, acid and frost, roaring her enemies into terror and birthing serpent-dragons. Guide her with her commands.
